job.title: Azure Cloud Engineer (m/w/d) bei Elevion GmbH – Jena

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211). Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Experienced with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, production troubleshooting, and working in techno-functional roles bridging business and IT stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team as an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer to contribute to your enterprise software solutions. With over five years of dedicated experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture & Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, ensuring high performance and adherence to platform best practices.

bullets.label: API Integrations & Headless Solutions
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize complex product catalogs across global channels while resolving integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical implementation by analysing processes, writing functional specifications, and collaborating directly with international stakeholders and development teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich um die Mitarbeit an Ihren Softwarelösungen innerhalb der SAP Commerce Cloud. Durch meine über fünfjährige Berufserfahrung als Softwareentwicklerin bei namhaften Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise in der Implementierung und Betreuung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten auf Basis von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring unter strikter Einhaltung von Best Practices.

bullets.label: API- und Schnittstellenintegration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Anpassung von Interceptors, Populators und Converters zur Realisierung maßgeschneiderter Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Daten- und Systemintegration
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines unter Verwendung von Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub zur kanalübergreifenden Synchronisation von Produktdaten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen, Erstellung von User Stories und enge Abstimmung mit internationalen Business- und IT-Teams zur erfolgreichen Lösungsfindung.

cover_de.logistics: Ich befinde mich in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und stehe Ihnen ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung (letzter Arbeitstag im aktuellen Unternehmen ist der 15.12.2026). Gerne überzeuge ich Sie in einem persönlichen Gespräch von meinem Mehrwert für Ihr Team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help your team build high-performing e-commerce software solutions. My background delivering complex integrations, OCC APIs, and robust backend architectures at enterprise scale makes me well-prepared to contribute effectively to your projects from day one.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, robust Java/Spring backend skills, and proven techno-functional expertise to build scalable e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am exploring new opportunities starting December 2026 and would love to connect regarding your SAP Commerce roles.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over five years of enterprise experience building and integrating SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring, and OCC API expertise.

I hold a valid German work permit, my last working day in my current role is 15 December 2026, and I can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
